payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_package.py::test_reverify_says_each_suites_line_through_emit_or_print failed with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/phases/package.py only by raising "TypeError: reverify() missing 1 required keyword-only argument: 'emit'", and no assertion failed. The claim was "`reverify` takes an optional `emit`. Handed one, it hands each suite's line to that `emit` as a `PhaseStart` with phase `PACKAGE`, label `re-verify` and the spec's id, and prints nothing. Handed none, it prints each line, on every call. Each line reads `re-verify: baseline suite at <new_base_sha cut to 12>`, then `re-verify: head suite at <packaged_sha cut to 12>`, as at your base. The witness drives one call with an `emit` and two calls without one, with two distinct shas whose characters vary along their length, and compares every line whole.".
